# Galaxy Sports Edge

> Galaxy Sports Edge is a quantitative sports analytics and predictive intelligence platform that blends advanced play-by-play simulation, real coaching tendencies, and deep situational reasoning to deliver plain-English NFL picks, DFS projections, and curated sports operator resources.

## Canonical Sections

- [/](https://www.galaxysportsedge.com/): Home platform overview, live model boards, and quantitative edge signals.
- [/packages](https://www.galaxysportsedge.com/packages): Galaxy Picks pay-per-slate storefront providing plain-English NFL game breakdowns, side/total picks, and player props.
- [/fantasy/dfs](https://www.galaxysportsedge.com/fantasy/dfs): DFS Lineup Builder and mathematical optimizer with constraint-based stacking and correlation modeling.
- [/resources/card-supplies](https://www.galaxysportsedge.com/resources/card-supplies): Pro Card Supplies & Operator Resources directory for grading protection, vault storage, studio desk hardware, and film study.
- [/api/content-os/packet](https://www.galaxysportsedge.com/api/content-os/packet): Live Content OS daily fuel packet API serving daily boards, visual packs, attribution partner kits, and creator workflows.
